description: This PHP source file manages the interface for adding a blocked device in a network management web application. It includes server-side logic, HTML structure, embedded PHP for dynamic content, client-side JavaScript for form validation and interactivity, and CSS styling. The file distinguishes itself by incorporating specific functions related to device management, user interface elements for device selection, blocking options, and scheduling configurations.

methods.description: Fetches a string value associated with a specified key, likely from configuration or device data.

methods.description: Retrieves instance IDs for a specific object path, used for listing device hosts.

methods.name: getParaValues
methods.description: Obtains parameter values for given object and parameter names, used for populating device info.
